albums.title: Goodbye
albums.description:
Hello lovely friends out there, Yes, again a new song. We truly think this is a masterpiece, hope you like it too! It is an acoustic one .. and it sounds like this song is about someone that committed suicide because life is too hard. Which is possible and I saw some souls in my mind while writing the lyrics indeed… We all know of friends or family members that tragically have chosen the fast way out! But at the same time .. it actually refers to the ego, your old self dying and becoming the version you dream of. This song could inspire you to become your better self, your higher self. Every day you get a new chance to work on it, change and grow into that image! 
Sending much healing energy and love to all of you! 
Never give up! 
Haleen
